summary: Sprint 1 brique 1 — 3rd testing pass after main agent's fix of the /api/connect/onboard 500 (Stripe Accounts v1 deprecation). CONFIRMED FIXED. POST /api/connect/onboard with pro.test@auxora.fr now returns HTTP 503 with structured detail {code:'STRIPE_CONNECT_UNAVAILABLE', message:'Stripe Connect Express n\'est pas encore activé sur ce compte. Activez « Accounts v1 support » dans le Dashboard Stripe → Settings → Connect.'} — NO bare 500 leaked. GET /api/connect/status stays 200 (iteration 23 fix still holds). Added new regression file test_sprint1_connect_onboard_no_500.py (4 tests, all passing) covering: artisan onboard never 500 (accepts 200 OR 503 with structured code), client onboard=403, no-auth=401, status=200. Full pytest suite is now 294 passed / 19 skipped / 0 failed / 0 errors in 91s (previous baseline 290/19/0 + 4 new onboard tests). Previous Sprint 1 smoke suite (10 tests) also 10/10 green. All review acceptance criteria met.

minor.endpoint: services/payments.py — remaining Stripe wrappers (create_payment_intent, create_subscription, get_or_create_customer, cancel_subscription)
minor.issue: These wrappers still call the live Stripe API without try/except. Only create_connect_account, create_account_link, retrieve_account, create_transfer, refund_payment are hardened. A transient Stripe outage or API change on the other wrappers can still surface as 500. Not blocking Sprint 1 but recommend adding a small @stripe_safe decorator mapping stripe.error.StripeError → 503 STRIPE_UNAVAILABLE for consistency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: extend the @stripe_safe pattern (StripeAccountUnavailable → 503) to create_payment_intent / create_subscription / get_or_create_customer / cancel_subscription — Sprint 1 review does not block on this but it will prevent future 500s on marketplace paths.

OPTIONAL: enable 'Accounts v1 support' in the Stripe Dashboard (https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/features/feat_accounts_v1_support) OR migrate create_connect_account to POST /v2/core/accounts so artisans can actually complete onboarding — right now every artisan gets 503. The endpoint is correct/safe but the happy-path is still blocked at the Stripe level.

OPTIONAL: routes/payments.py:52-63 still inserts the stripe_accounts row BEFORE create_account_link succeeds — with the new 503 path this is no longer strictly buggy (row is inserted only on the create-account branch), but if create_account_link then raises StripeAccountUnavailable the DB row exists without a functional link. Consider inserting only after link creation succeeds.
critical_code_review_comments: services/payments.py:200-234 — StripeAccountUnavailable pattern is clean: InvalidRequestError → structured French message + logger.error, StripeError → generic 'temporairement indisponible' fallback. Route translates to 503 with machine-readable code. Good separation of concerns.

services/payments.py:246-264 — create_account_link catches InvalidRequestError AND PermissionError which is correct (v1-deprecated new accounts will fail the link step too). Message correctly says 'compte doit être recréé'.

services/payments.py:237-244 — StripeAccountUnavailable class defined AFTER create_connect_account uses it (line 226). Works at runtime because Python resolves names at call time, but ordering is a minor readability nit — move the class definition ABOVE the wrappers.

rca_of_issue: Previous iteration's bug: services/payments.py::create_connect_account bare-called stripe.Account.create(type='express') which Stripe rejected with InvalidRequestError ('Accounts v1 deprecated'), producing a bare 500. Fix applied by main agent: (1) added StripeAccountUnavailable(RuntimeError) exception class; (2) wrapped stripe.Account.create in try/except catching stripe.error.InvalidRequestError → raises StripeAccountUnavailable with French message pointing to Dashboard toggle, and stripe.error.StripeError → generic 'temporarily unavailable' message; (3) same defensive wrap on create_account_link catching InvalidRequestError/PermissionError; (4) routes/payments.py::connect_onboard catches StripeAccountUnavailable and returns HTTPException(status_code=503, detail={code:'STRIPE_CONNECT_UNAVAILABLE', message:str(exc)}). Verification: curl POST /api/connect/onboard with valid artisan token → HTTP 503 with the expected structured detail. Backend log shows no traceback (exception caught cleanly). Regression test added at /app/backend/tests/test_sprint1_connect_onboard_no_500.py to guard against future regressions.
